title: Night time tour of Nasrid Palaces, Alhambra
text:
I went on a night time English speaking guided tour of the Nasrid Palaces at Alhambra, guided by Nacho last night. I was lucky that it was a small group of only 5. Nacho was knowledgeable, and caring about the building, the area and its history. It was great. He answered questions easily and provided a lot of interesting information relevant to the palaces, their history and historical context.

title: Night Alhambra
text:
I went on the 17th with my parents, sister and partner and it was a very nice experience for the 5. 
The visit was with Natalia, a countrywoman from Jaén, and you could see that she has been dedicated to this for years because she had a lot of freedom explaining and told many interesting anecdotes. Moreover, he always asked for doubts or if anything had not been clear, very nice the truth. 
I had previously done the tour a few years ago with them and it is worth repeating without any doubt.
